profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Legacy Mutual Mortgage
profile.summary:
Results-driven technology professional with 35+ years of progressive experience across software

engineering, solutions architecture, and IT leadership. Recognized for designing and delivering custom

integrations, automation workflows, and business applications — primarily within mortgage and financial

services environments. 

Equally effective as a hands-on engineer writing production code and as an architect shaping enterprise-wide systems. Deep expertise in Encompass/ICE Mortgage Technology, Microsoft 365 Power Platform, REST API integrations, robotic process automation, and cloud infrastructure.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Architect of Customized Business Solutions, Multi-faceted Software Developer and Deployment Specialist in the Mortgage Banking industry. Primarily involved in Ice Mortgage Encompass integrations via SDK and API to the Azure Power Platform, Office365 & SharePoint as well as Custom Web Portals.

positions.title: Business Applications Specialist
positions.description: Skills: JavaScript · Web Applications · HTML · Cross-browser Compatibility · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JSON

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description: I am pleased to continue working with TheLab.ms in a new leadership role. New initiatives and new challenges await. Technology is not new area for  me and maximizing the extents of the organizations technological capabilities in a nearly zero budget environment is the present plan of action.

positions.title: President
positions.description:
I have achieved many wonderful successes as President at TheLab.ms during the past three years. Term limits forced me to change my responsibilities but I will always be a lifelong advocate for the organization and its goals.

The mission of TheLab.ms is to foster a collaborative environment wherein people can explore and create intersections between technology, science, art, and culture.

Our goals for success:

    Acquire & maintain a collaborative work space.
    Foster a creative, collaborative environment.
    Interact with the local community through education and cultural participation.
    Share our developments and ideas.
    Facilitate communication with other spaces.
    Invite experts and creative individuals to share their ideas.
